subject: Pen test closure — evidence index & suggested validation window for Needlepoint Health
messages:
From: Samir Mehta <samir@needlepoint.health>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to validate remediations and schedule retest

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the pen test remediations. Our security ops team reviewed the updated notes you sent and we'd like to schedule a validation scan (third-party retest) as soon as you can provide a consolidated evidence package and a short confirmation of the implemented mitigations.

What we need from Redwood before our vendor runs the retest (CrowdSec):
- A remediation matrix mapping each finding ID to status, fix commit or config change, PR/CL link, and date of deployment.
- Proof-of-fix artifacts for high/critical findings (screenshots, log snippets, patch diff or deploy IDs).
- Updated attestation that issues listed in the 2027-09-20 report have been closed or accepted with residual risk documented.
- A proposed 48–72 hour window for the retest and contact details for the person who will support CrowdSec during the scan.

We attached our summary of outstanding items (needlepoint_pt_v2_comments.pdf) for reference. Ideally we can run validation the week of Oct 4–8; please advise if you can support those dates.

Samir Mehta
Security Operations
Needlepoint Health
samir@needlepoint.health

---
Attachment: needlepoint_pt_v2_comments.pdf (PDF, 510KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Mehta <samir@needlepoint.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to validate remediations and schedule retest

Samir — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our remediation and platform leads so we can assemble a single package and confirm a scan window.

Marissa / Rishi / Vivek — Samir from Needlepoint is asking for a consolidated evidence index and a 48–72 hour validation window. I’ve attached their comments. Can you confirm by EOD which artifacts we can produce and whether Oct 6–8 works for a retest? Specifically please provide:
- remediation_matrix_v3.xlsx (status + PR/commit + deploy timestamp)
- proof-of-fix items (screenshots, log exports, or short replay steps) for HIGH/Critical findings
- an updated attestation letter (brief paragraph signed by T&S owner)
- who will be our point-of-contact for CrowdSec on the day of the scan (name + mobile/email)

I’ll coordinate scheduling with Samir once we have internal confirmation.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0170

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to validate remediations and schedule retest — remediation artifacts attached

Hi all,

Attached: remediation_matrix_v3.xlsx and a zipped evidence bundle (evidence_bundle_needlepoint.zip). Notes below — please read before we commit to a retest window.

Summary of status:
- All Critical (C1) findings: fixed and deployed to prod (deploy IDs and PRs included in the matrix). Proof-of-fix: config snapshots + post-deploy logs.
- High (H) findings: fixes applied; two items are configurable mitigations dependent on customer-supplied tokens (we flagged these in the matrix under "customer action required").
- Medium/Low (M/L): most remediated; two low-risk items remain intentionally deferred (documented as accepted residual risk with rationale).

Outstanding clarifications required before CrowdSec runs a full validation:
1) Needlepoint must confirm that the staging endpoint (staging.dp.needlepoint.health) is in scope for the retest — we currently only exposed production. If they want staging included, we need explicit scope confirmation and credentials/backchannel for the scanner.
2) For the two config-dependent High findings, we need Needlepoint to confirm they have applied the recommended token rotation in their environment (Samir — can you confirm?).

Proposed retest window: Oct 6 (10:00–18:00 PT) through Oct 7 for any follow-ups. We can support CrowdSec during those times; our support POC will be Rishi (rishi@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0199).

Attachments included: remediation_matrix_v3.xlsx (Excel, 42KB) — includes mapping to original report IDs and evidence file names. evidence_bundle_needlepoint.zip (zip, ~8MB) — contains screenshots, logs, and short replay steps for high findings.

If Needlepoint confirms scope and token rotation, we can finalize scheduling.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Date: 2027-10-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final evidence index and proposed validation window (Oct 6)

Samir — thanks for your patience. Attached is our consolidated evidence index and proof-of-fix bundle. We can support CrowdSec for a retest starting Oct 6 at 10:00 AM PT; Rishi will be our on-call POC for the scan (rishi@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0199).

What we attached: needlepoint_pt_v2_redwood_comments.pdf (your original comments), remediation_matrix_v3.xlsx (full mapping + deploy stamps), evidence_bundle_needlepoint.zip (screenshots, logs, replay steps). Also included in the matrix is a short attestation paragraph signed by our T&S lead confirming closure for Critical/High items where fixes were applied.

Two small asks before CrowdSec kicks off:
- Please confirm that staging.dp.needlepoint.health is out of scope for this run (we currently only made production endpoints available). If you want staging included, provide explicit confirmation and credentials/backchannel.
- Confirm token rotation for the two config-dependent High findings (Samir — can you reply with a quick yes/no).

If we don’t hear back by 9:00 AM PT on Oct 6, we’ll start the scan against production only and proceed based on the matrix.

Link to evidence index (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/evidence-index

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0170
